# Labyu — Filipino Founders Directory
# https://alieninc.tech/labyu/

## Companies

- PayMongo: Online payments for the Philippines. https://alieninc.tech/labyu/c/paymongo/
- NextPay: Digital banking for Philippine small businesses. https://alieninc.tech/labyu/c/nextpay/
- Alien Inc: Seven independent companies, one operating system. https://alieninc.tech/labyu/c/alien-inc/
- Kumu: Livestreaming and social entertainment for Filipinos. https://alieninc.tech/labyu/c/kumu/
- Kalibrr: Jobs and hiring for the Philippines. https://alieninc.tech/labyu/c/kalibrr/
